verdicts.title: A General Method for Constructing Ramanujan Formulas for $1/π^ν$
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: In this article we give the theoretical background for generating Ramanujan type $1/π^{2ν}$ formulas. As applications of our method we give a general construction of $1/π^4$ series and examples of $1/π^6$ series. We also study the elliptic alpha function whose values are useful for such evaluations.
verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract discusses Ramanujan formulas for $1/π^ν$, which does not interact with the specific claim about Φ(π)/proof_size being monotone increasing in n, as it pertains to a different mathematical context.

verdicts.title: A family of Ramanujan-Orr formulas for $1/π$
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We use a variant of Wan's method to prove two Ramanujan-Orr type formulas for $1/π$. This variant needs to know in advance the formulas for $1/π$ that we want to prove, but avoids the need of solving a system of equations.
verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract of the cited paper discusses Ramanujan-Orr type formulas for $1/π$ and does not mention anything related to resolution proof complexity, Tseitin formulas, or the monotonicity of Φ(π)/proof_size. Therefore, it does not support or refute the conjecture.

verdicts.title: Relations between $π$ and the golden ratio $φ$ in the form of Bailey-Borwein-Plouffe-type formulas
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We provide a family of expressions of $π$ in terms of the golden ratio $φ$ in the same spirit of the formula obtained by Bailey, Borwein and Plouffe for $π$. Connection with cyclotomic polynomials is outlined.
verdicts.judge_reasoning: The cited abstract discusses expressions of π in terms of the golden ratio φ and their connection to cyclotomic polynomials. This topic is unrelated to the conjecture about the monotonicity of Φ(π)/proof_size with respect to n, as it pertains to mathematical expressions rather than proof complexity.
